{{Quote|This is obviously an act of terrorism. What did the Republic do to stop this? Where are our Jedi? That's it for Tynna. I'll be contacting Count Dooku once we can establish new government headquarters somewhere.|Razelfiin|<ref name="HNN" />}}
The '''Tynna Central Government Building''' was located in [[Lutris]] on<ref name="HNN" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]], and was the seat of the [[Tynnan government]]<ref name="HNN" /> shortly before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|onset]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="CSWE Razelfiin">{{CSWECite|III|84|Razelfiin}}</ref> fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="TEA" /> the Tynna Central Government Building collapsed due to a [[Stone mite/Legends|stone mite]] infestation. Local security was alerted to the destruction by [[General Council Assistant]] [[Zobyteeg]], who was afforded a view of nearby [[Lutris Lake]] when his [[Viewport/Legends|window]]-less office wall disappeared; the premises were thereafter evacuated. Recently-elected [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] planetary leader [[Razelfiin]] was indignant at the lack of Republic or [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] intervention in the matter, blaming the collapse on [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorism]], and announced her intentions to reach out to<ref name="HNN" /> Separatist [[Head of State/Legends|leader]]<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] as soon as a new seat of government could be located.<ref name="HNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tynna Central Government Building was featured on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]] in the [[in-universe]] issue [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 53|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #53'']], published<ref name="HNN" /> on [[April 25]], [[2002]]<ref name="HNN53 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6586618|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=Mastadge|date=2002-04-25|time=5:54 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305125429/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-13}}</ref> and written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="HNN Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
